title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative: The programme in Niger helps to improve access to basic needs and the rights to life, access to food, water, shelter and medical assistance for vulnerable people affected by humanitarian crises in 35 communities in Ouallam, Mirriah and Gouré in Niger. In 2024, GOAL directly reached 40,052 people in various sectors. Thanks to this programme, women's empowerment and decision-making are improved within communities through income-generating activities (VSLA). Access to basic healthcare is improved for people, particularly women and children, in areas where access to sanitation facilities is difficult. The programme supports vulnerable households and people with disabilities affected by multiple shocks. In addition, the programme provides access to smart farming techniques adapted to climate change in rural communities to improve diversification and consumption of a variety of micronutrient-rich foods.. OVERALL COUNTRY PROG: Outcome 3: People Have Food & Nutrition Security. SPECIFIC OUTCOME: Integrating actions focused on the crop sub-systems to build adaptive, sustainable livelihoods and food security. This includes nutrition and climate smart crop production and market systems development for climate resilient jobs and enterprises.
